contract.intent: Produce the functional-spec — the detailed contract of what the builder can DO with Ann: the function surface (F1-F16), per-function contracts (purpose → AC/KPI traceability, inputs, outputs, interactions/gates, failure edges, verification), the interaction model (gate talk-loop), and the v1 views section (tree view, step card, status, gate presentation). Fills the missing layer between requirements and architecture.
acceptanceCriteria: functional-spec.md artifact exists at artifacts/ — complete: function surface + per-function contracts + interaction model + v1 views
Every function traces to AC/KPI/NFR (requirements-spec v3) and to components (ann-system-design) via mapping tables
Interaction model defined once: gate talk-loop (present card -> collect decision -> collect feedback), referenced by all functions
Failure edges per function: fail-closed, blocker named, no fabrication
Views section for v1 (CLI text): tree view, step card contents, status display, gate presentation — the K1-K3 measurable surface
Spec locked (type=spec, upstream requirements-spec + flow-control-spec); indexed in AGENTS.md; resolvable via resolve.mjs
